tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Renato speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
✨ Ability gained: Long Table (L1). Share food with everyone in camp to reduce their hunger. Costs 300 kcal; once a day.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Jerome's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
🖱️ The Algorithm trailers its next move at Zihao — the predictable get countered.

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −16. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 21 days between tiers, not 7.

◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −20. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 23 days between tiers, not 7.
